# Southern Living

> > Southern Living is the definitive guide to Southern cuisine, hospitality, home design, gardening, and travel across the American South.

Founded as a celebration of Southern culture and lifestyle, Southern Living offers authoritative recipes, home and garden advice, travel recommendations, and product reviews. The magazine and website feature contributions from culinary experts like Robert F. Moss and cover everything from traditional Southern cooking techniques to modern product launches from brands like French's, Maker's Mark, and regional favorites like Publix.

## Key Topics

- Southern cooking and recipes
- BBQ and cookout traditions
- Bourbon and whiskey culture
- Easter and holiday entertaining
- Home accessibility and design
- Southern travel destinations
- Garden and landscape care
- New product launches and reviews
- Regional restaurant spotlights
- Condiments and flavor trends
- Swicy (sweet-spicy) flavors
- Historic Southern cuisine
- Seasonal cooking and entertaining
- Southern hospitality traditions

## Recipes & Cooking

- [Easy Chicken And Dumplings Recipe](https://www.southernliving.com/recipes/easy-chicken-dumplings): Quick chicken and dumplings recipe using deli chicken and biscuits
- [63 Recipes That Use Worcestershire Sauce](https://www.southernliving.com/worcestershire-sauce-recipes-6534256): Collection of 63 Southern recipes featuring Worcestershire sauce
- [30 Easter Lunch Ideas That Feel Fancy (But Are So Easy)](https://www.southernliving.com/easy-easter-lunch-ideas-11911491): 30 easy Easter lunch recipes featuring seasonal spring produce
- [French Onion Pork Chops Recipe](https://www.southernliving.com/french-onion-pork-chops-11883016): Skillet pork chops with caramelized onions and melted cheese topping
- [15 Non-Alcoholic Easter Punch Recipes For Your Spring Menu](https://www.southernliving.com/non-alcoholic-easter-punch-recipes-11919249): 15 family-friendly non-alcoholic punch recipes for Easter gatherings
- [The Salad Nashville Has Been Craving For Over A Century](https://www.southernliving.com/faucon-salad-11892418): Historic Faucon Salad from 1896 Nashville, predecessor to wedge salad
